g.text: StartLux — one exploratory run, no SD
Strict clean 5,955 comparison: TC at the middle quality-target range, as a percentage of all-cloud
generation cost (lower is better). TC is normalized only by the actual 5,955 clean full_cloud_cost.
Baseline: 9 previous methods, SD across the actual repeats named in the table notes. StartLux: one
exploratory execution per condition (no SD). pending = condition not complete at this snapshot, not zero.
The current paper tables are a separate, protocol-mismatched reference; do not combine them with this table.
Baseline: 9 previous methods from the strict 5,955 sources; BQ/TC normalized by the actual 5,955 Qcloud/full_cloud_cost.
Repeat identity: SelfAsk/Entropy/MaxLogits/Conf. Margin = 3 fixed executions; Emb. MLP/HybridLLM/RouteLLM/MeanProbe = 3
training seeds; Jev = 3 actual API executions. A reported 0.00 is a measured sample SD for identical fixed executions, not a
StartLux: one exploratory execution per condition; no SD. pending = condition not complete, not zero.
The paper reference is separate and protocol-mismatched (PAPER_REFERENCE.md); do not combine the two tables or rank them
